title: Equipping the Saints
definition: Equipping the Saints is the ministry of preparing believers for service, maturity, unity, and faithfulness in Christ.
summary: Equipping the Saints is the Church's work of preparing believers for ministry, maturity, and service.
christFocus: Jesus Christ gives ministry gifts to build up His body toward maturity.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Equipping the saints is the church's work of preparing believers for ministry, maturity, and service. Scripture teaches that leaders do not do all ministry for the church; they equip the body to serve.

Equipping involves teaching Scripture, forming character, developing gifts, correcting error, and helping believers obey Christ in real life. It turns spectators into servants.

Jesus gives leaders and gifts to His church so the whole body may grow. Equipping is one way Christ builds His people in truth and love.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because churches become weak when believers are entertained but not trained. Equipping helps ordinary Christians know Scripture, serve wisely, and stand firm in a confusing world.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Do not only ask what church can provide for you; ask how you can be trained to serve Christ. Leaders should measure ministry not by dependence on them, but by the maturing faithfulness of the saints.
